(8) Prior to being removed under subsection (7), the EC
Director General shall be issued a notice in writing to show
cause as to why he should not be removed from office and be
given an opportunity of being heard against any allegations
made against him.
(9) The office of the EC Director General shall become
vacant upon the death, removal from office under subsection
(7) or resignation by letter in that behalf addressed to the
Minister by the holder of that office.
(10) If any vacancy occurs in the office of the EC Director
General,  the  Minister  may,  in  consultation  with  the  EC
Board, appoint an appointed member of the Board to exercise,
perform and discharge the powers, duties and functions of
the EC Director General until an appointment is made under
subsection (1).
(11)  The  EC  Director  General  shall  be  paid  such
remuneration  as  may  be  determined  by  the  EC  Board  in
consultation with the Minister.
